notes.title: New game Herdling
notes.content:
After working for more than two years in the dark, [b]Okomotive[/b] is proud and happy to present their brand new IP and upcoming game «[b]HERDLING[/b]».

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33976734/f83796f984d94a394296f2ce93285e7acc0e8bec.png[/img]

Herdling is a new adventure from [b]Okomotive[/b], creators of the atmospheric and acclaimed [b]FAR games[/b], and [b]Panic[/b], publishers of [b]Firewatch[/b].

Head out on a grand alpine expedition with a herd of loveable beasts, as you ascend a mountain path, encounter eerie dangers and surprising obstacles, and forge your way to the mystery at the summit.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tUEcKBVzhQg
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Guide, protect, and fall in love with a motley herd of Calicorns
[*]Traverse stunning mountainscapes, fog-wreathed forests, snowy plateaus, and forgotten valleys
[*]Hone your herding skills as you navigate a wide range of challenges, threats, and light environmental puzzles
[*]Feel the rush of the mountain air alongside your herd in exhilarating stampede sequences
[*]An emotional, wordless tale of trust, survival, and companionship during a great crossing through a fallen world
[/list]
Release date: 2025
Platforms: PC & Consoles
[url=https://www.herdling.game] Visit herdling.game [/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3047750/Herdling/

notes.title: FAR: Changing Tides sets sail on 1st March
notes.content:
Embark on an unforgettable journey when FAR: Changing Tides launches on 1st March 2022.  FAR: Changing Tides follows the emotional story of a boy who must navigate a post-apocalyptic, flooded landscape at the helm of a unique ship. Solve puzzles, battle the elements and dive to unknown depths for precious fuel and salvage as you progress through this stunningly-realised world. 

[previewyoutube=sXiOLxtAVV8;full][/previewyoutube]

The FAR: Changing Tides Digital Deluxe Edition is also now available to pre-order, this edition includes the base game and the FAR: Changing Tides OST which features 34 tracks of original music from Joel Schoch. 

[h2]Key Features: [/h2]

AN ALL-NEW COMPANION TITLE
Expanding on the desolate setting seen in FAR: Lone Sails, Changing Tides swaps sun scorched, dusty planes for stormy skies and high seas. With new environments, puzzles, and ship mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28509748/a9db268993aed45ed2ecee80fd006ac0830dc80c.png[/img] 

A FIGHT FOR SURVIVAL
Overcome the elements as new protagonist, Toe, who awakens to find themselves alone, stranded in a flooded world. What once was home is transformed into an unfamiliar and sometimes hostile environment.

CAPTAIN YOUR SHIP
Experience the thrill of captaining a distinctive seafaring vessel. Together you’ll brave high seas, navigate intense storms, and plumb the perils of a briny deep in search of precious fuel and salvage. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28509748/c74783688bbef897b4f96f71790c16308e576fa5.png[/img]

A MEDITATIVE EXPERIENCE
Captaining your extraordinary ship, raise the mast, angle and billow the sails, light the furnace and more as you learn to sail the ocean while mourning the loss of your home.

SOUNDS OF THE OCEAN
A dynamic soundtrack reacts to player and environmental actions, amplifying key moments in the game and heightening the atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28509748/a9db268993aed45ed2ecee80fd006ac0830dc80c.png[/img]
 
If you want to keep up to date with all the FAR: Changing Tides news, then head to [url=https://www.farchangingtides.com/]www.farchangingtides.com[/url] and sign up for the Newsletter, or follow FAR: Changing Tides on [url=https://twitter.com/FARtheGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/FARtheGame]Facebook[/url], and [url=https://www.instagram.com/FARtheGame/]Instagram[/url].

notes.title: Gamescom & Indie Arena Booth: Q & A session on Discord
notes.content:
We're looking forward to being part of this year's Gamescom and Indie Arena Booth! To seize the opportunity, we will be hosting a Q & A session on [url=http://discord.gg/mixtvision][b]Discord[/b][/url] on [b]August 28, 2pm CEST / 5am PDT[/b]. Ask us anything about "FAR: Lone Sails" - we're looking forward to chatting with you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28509748/23cbf231cb7b4294ae57ed6ad4bacd9ce07e917e.jpg[/img]

[b]About the game:[/b]

Traverse a dried-out seabed littered with the remains of a decaying civilization. Keep your unique vessel going, overcome numerous obstacles and withstand the hazardous weather conditions. How far can you make it? What will you find?
[list]
[*] Master your vessel: Maintain and upgrade your vehicle to overcome numerous obstacles and natural hazards.
[*] Discover a unique world: Explore a desolate dried-out seabed, follow the trails of your people and find relics and buildings, that tell the story of a civilization on the run.
[*] Experience an atmospheric journey: Let the sky full of clouds pass by and heed the wind that drives your sails towards the horizon.
[*] A Zombie-free Post-Apocalypse: It’s just you and your machine vs. the big nothing.
[/list]

[b]Explore:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/609320/FAR_Lone_Sails/

... and visit our booth at the [url=https://online.indiearenabooth.com/]Indie Arena Booth[/url]!

notes.title: Special offer for adventure game fans
notes.content:
Holiday season has started and everyone is looking for gifts that spark joy with the recipient - or for great deals to treat themselves! That's why FAR's publisher Mixtvision has teamed up with Application Systems Heidelberg and Daedalic Entertainment to bring you the "[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12778/Atmospheric_Adventure_Bundle/]Atmospheric Adventure Bundle[/url]" – or, as we like to call it: a bundle of joy!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12778/Atmospheric_Adventure_Bundle/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33168999/72130ec24b9969f0c49543578962cb76889b128b.png[/img][/url] 

This bundle contains three games presenting atmospheric experiences in worlds with exceptional art styles! You save 10% on the bundle - and that is on top of any other discount that might be in place! If you already own one or two of the games, you can complete the set and get the bundle discount, as well.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/609320/FAR_Lone_Sails/]FAR: Lone Sails[/url][/h1]
Traverse a dried-out seabed littered with the remains of a decaying civilization. Keep your unique vessel going, overcome numerous obstacles and withstand the hazardous weather conditions. How far can you make it? What will you find?

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/501790/Unforeseen_Incidents/]Unforeseen Incidents[/url][/h1]
A classical style interactive mystery set in a beautifully hand-painted world. Join Harper Pendrell and experience a challenging investigation, smart dialog and a rich cast of characters in this thrilling adventure game.

[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/331870/AER_Memories_of_Old/]AER Memories of Old[/url][/h1]
Transform into a bird and fly to explore and experience a vibrant world of floating islands in the sky. Venture down into lost ancient ruins where each step leads you closer to the end of the world.

[h1]We hope our offers help to keep you all joyful during Holiday Season![/h1]

Last but not least, here's a little something you could do to warm our hearts, as well: PlayStation.Blog has just opened the poll for their [b]Game of the Year awards[/b] and FAR is amongst the nominees for "Best Art Direction" and "Best Independent Game". If you could spare a minute and [url=https://blog.us.playstation.com/2019/12/09/polls-open-playstation-blog-game-of-the-year-2019/][b]vote for us[/b][/url], that would mean a lot to us (and would definitely spark joy)!

Team [i]FAR: Lone Sails[/i]

notes.title: Get 10% off Interrogation - Mixtvision's latest game - until Dec 19th!
notes.content:
Hello Travellers!

Today, exciting news from a far away land reach us: [i]Interrogation: You will be deceived[/i] from developer Critique Gaming is now available on PC, Mac and Linux. 
In this latest game from FAR’s publisher Mixtvision, you must step into the gumshoes of a detective leading a squad that’s been tasked with thwarting the plans of a shadowy and powerful terrorist group known as the Liberation Front. With the clock ticking you’ll need to use the game’s realistic conversational system to interrogate and emotionally manipulate suspects, unmask the perpetrators and avert disaster. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X7yFCXGFSGc
To thank all of you for supporting us, we want to give you a little gift: [b]all owners of FAR get 10% off for Interrogation[/b] until December 19th! Grab it while it’s hot. ;) 
[list]
[*] Psychologically manipulate suspects to prevent the Liberation Front’s next attack
[*] Manage a team, resources and uphold the police force’s reputation
[*] Gritty, visually striking noir art-style based on thousands of photos from real actors  
[*] Play your own style with branching paths leading to multiple endings
[*] Atmospheric music to increase the growing tension
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.21
notes.content:
1.21 Patch Notes

[list]
[*]macOS: code-signed and notarized app for macOS Catalina.
[*]Fixed several issues where the character could get stuck or fall through geometry within obstacles or in the vehicle.
[*]Fixed issue where the ground / terrain of the next chapter won’t load.
[*]Fixed several localization issues.
[*]Fixed a bug where the background started to flicker once the player opened the menu during the gameplay.
[*]Fixed bugs with the save game selection in the menu.
[*]Fixed clunky behavior of the vehicle hooks.
[*]Fixed interpolation of the visuals with enabled vsync options.
[*]Performance optimization: this version includes all the improvements we made for PS4, XB1 and Switch. Since the consoles use multi-core GPUs this still doesn’t mean that the game will run much better on an integrated low-end GPU. For mid-range GPUs we should have an increase of 20-30% of the framerate. The game should also have less hiccups since we could move some operations to the background thread and to the GPU.
[/list]

notes.title: Giveaway and sale to celebrate LudoNarraCon!
notes.content:
We know, we know, our last giveaway [i]just[/i] ended, but we loved your entries so much that we wanted to give back even more to the community.
We put together [b]one last fan package[/b] with an amazing [b]exclusive art print[/b] on Aluminum Dibond (approx. 21,6 x 9,8 in), an [b]exclusive t-shirt[/b] (we will ask you about the size and you can chose men's or women's fit), a USB stick, a set of postcards and stickers.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28509748/fce052e49591bf813a6b2abd8cdac5e2c663b113.jpg[/img]
To enter, you have to join our [url=https://discord.gg/N2ZmRaU]Discord[/url] and tell us which cool / funny / awesome upgrade YOU would give the trusty vehicle from FAR! You have [b]until the 10th of May 9 PM CEST (12 PM PDT)[/b] to tell us all about your brilliant ideas, which is when we will pick the best answer and announce the winner.
The giveaway is also kicking off a [b]sale[/b] to celebrate the first edition of [url=https://www.ludonarracon.com]LudoNarracon[/url], an online convention celebrating narrative video games organized by our friends at [url=http://fellowtraveller.games]FellowTraveller[/url] that takes place on [b]Steam May 10 - 13[/b].
We are looking forward to your awesome ideas and talking to you on our server. See you there!
- Rebekka

notes.title: Visit us at Gamescom!! Also, production update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28509748/d8087cd39547e0e3606f346c9c57e8fbe8933b09.png[/img]


Hey everyone! I have some ...

[h1]Event News[/h1]

We're at Gamescom 2017 (August 22 - 26) in Cologne, Germany, where we'll show "FAR: Lone Sails" at the Indie Arena Booth (Hall 10.1, A-020)!

If any of you are around, please come by and check out our [b]new pre-alpha demo build[/b]! For those who can't make it: there's a new gameplay video on our Steam store page and on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o_a7f5GNh9E]Youtube[/url]!

We'll also be selling prints of one of our head designer Don Schmocker's artworks for a modest fee at our booth this year, if you're interested in that.


[h1]Production News[/h1]

We’ll be launching the [b]Alpha version of FAR: Lone Sails[/b] for internal testing in September! A big milestone for us that we’re very excited about and also a big step towards putting the game on digital store shelves. That, however, will have to wait a tiny bit longer than originally anticipated as we’re pushing the expected Steam release into Q1 2018. This will give us some extra time to oil the engine, crank the sails and smash full speed through the remaining obstacles! 

Thanks for taking the time to catch up on FAR!

– Frieder, Team FAR: Lone Sails
